messages:
Ravi (Sales): Quick help — enterprise POC (GloboBank) wants a 30% off list for a 60-day multi-region trial; they're asking that we honor old commit credit rules if they convert. POC uses Hosted + VPC egress to EU + APAC.
Mari - RevOps: Need the POC start date, avg usage, and whether they have an existing commit.
Ravi (Sales): Started 2026-04-10, avg 200k tokens/day, no existing commit. Customer worried about rate card changes scheduled next month.
Jules (DealDesk): For no-commit trials, we usually don't provide commit credit. We can approve a one-time onboarding discount for trials under a threshold. Submit DD-8533 with usage estimate and region note.
Omar (Finance): Rough calc: 200k/day * 30 = 6M tokens/month. At list $0.02/token, 30% off is ~$36k/month. Need approval band + justification.
Compliance Bot: Reminder: Multi-region VPC requires SOC2 addendum and DPA review before trial data ingress.
Mari - RevOps: Two options: 1) Approve a 60-day 20% onboarding discount (no commit credit), or 2) Approve 30% if Sales secures a 6-month commit and DealDesk signs off. Which does Sales want to pursue?
Ravi (Sales): I'll ask for option 2 and start DD-8533. If they push back, we'll take option 1 to keep momentum.
Jules (DealDesk): I'll pre-fill DD-8533 with mapped SKUs and region flags. Tagging @Omar for expedited review once submitted.
Omar (Finance): Ping me on DD-8533 and include expected ARR conversion probability.
Mari - RevOps: Noted — provisional: "trial_onboarding_discount: 20% (auto) / 30% (conditional on 6mo commit + DealDesk approval)." Pasteable for quote.
Ravi (Sales): Thanks team — opening DD-8533 now. Will update with customer's commit appetite.
